title: P-Delta amplification of a cantilever column
description: Cantilever column with axial load P (about 31 % of the Euler load) and lateral tip load H, second-order analysis with 8 elements.
source: Exact beam-column solution: Timoshenko & Gere, Theory of Elastic Stability, art. 1.4; approximate amplification factor 1/(1 - P/Pcr)

checks.label: Tip sway vs exact beam-column solution
Base moment vs exact beam-column solution

checks.note: The amplification factor is itself an approximation, so a difference of about 1 % is expected.
